details.title: Like Someone in Love
details.lead: Jimmy Van Heusen, 1944, words by Johnny Burke. The chorus as it is written, with its last ending, in C major: concert D4 to E5. Each A starts on four E’s, then turns up to A and back down; the B leans on C♯ and B, then holds a long low E, or D and D♯, before the line comes back. In two; the lead sheet marks it fast, here about 96 a minute.
